recommendation: Keep the audit as-is and do not re-add dateEnded unless Pharmacy resolves a new tracker that supersedes FHIR-8442/FHIR-32412 or changes the current statusChanged/eventHistory model.
issue_request: FHIR-5911 asked to consider a MedicationPrescription dateEnded element for completed, entered-in-error, stopped, superseded/hold-like statuses, with the final Published/Persuasive with Modification resolution agreeing a date was needed for some statuses and tying the change to status review.
initial_application: Historical commit 70483d7d71eda1846ef9c7d8b30f8bc7fbca1470 initially added MedicationPrescription.dateEnded as a 0..1 dateTime. After the resource became MedicationOrder, commit adf4e89f89fd36602f6b6e7520c1025949477424 applied FHIR-8442/FHIR-9301 by removing MedicationOrder.dateEnded and reasonEnded and adding eventHistory.
additional_context: FHIR-8442 is a later Published decision that explicitly superseded the dateEnded element. FHIR-32412 is a later Published decision that added MedicationRequest.statusChanged 0..1 dateTime for when the current status took effect; it is already audited on the combined branch. Current MedicationRequest is active in fhir.ini and still contains statusChanged and eventHistory. No direct FHIR-5911 Confluence or Zulip references were found; a related Zulip thread confirms the dateEnded removal rationale.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Reintroducing dateEnded would conflict with FHIR-8442 and duplicate the current statusChanged element, while eventHistory covers relevant lifecycle history through Provenance references.

related_jiras.note: Later Published Pharmacy decision removed MedicationOrder.dateEnded/reasonEnded and added eventHistory, superseding the original FHIR-5911 dateEnded application.

Later Published Pharmacy decision added the current MedicationRequest.statusChanged element for the current status date; already represented on the combined branch by c1a45b49e573a2eb98167fcd335cfbbff732ce9a.
Retracted/no-change eventHistory binding issue notes eventHistory changed to a Provenance reference, matching the current eventHistory shape.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive with Modification Pharmacy WG DSTU1 issue asking to consider dateEnded for MedicationPrescription statuses such as completed, entered-in-error, stopped, and superseded/hold.
evidence_items.learned: The seed establishes a need for a status-ending/status-change date, with the final resolution tied to the broader medication status review rather than a fixed permanent element name.

evidence_items.summary: Historical commit #5911 added MedicationPrescription.dateEnded as a 0..1 dateTime element described as when the prescription was stopped.
evidence_items.learned: FHIR-5911 was initially applied in source before later Pharmacy decisions changed the model.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive with Modification issue whose resolution said to clarify initial date/prescriber semantics, add eventHistory, and remove dateEnded and reasonEnded.
evidence_items.learned: This later final decision intentionally superseded the original dateEnded element.

evidence_items.summary: Historical commit for GF#8442/GF#9301 removed MedicationOrder.dateEnded and reasonEnded and added eventHistory.
evidence_items.learned: The current absence of dateEnded follows an explicit later source change, not an incomplete application of FHIR-5911.

evidence_items.summary: MedicationRequest is active in the build, statusChanged is present as a 0..1 dateTime, and eventHistory references Provenance records for relevant lifecycle transitions.
evidence_items.learned: The current build-scope source already contains the status date and lifecycle-history mechanisms relevant to the seed.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive R5 issue requesting MedicationRequest StatusChanged 0..1 dateTime for when the current status took effect.
evidence_items.learned: This later final decision supplies the current direct field for the date associated with the current MedicationRequest status.

evidence_items.locator: PHAR May 2021 Virtual WGM Minutes page 104570783
evidence_items.summary: Minutes reference FHIR-32412 and record agreement that the date something was put on hold is useful while the modeling was discussed.
evidence_items.learned: Meeting evidence supports the later statusChanged model and does not revive dateEnded.

evidence_items.summary: Melva Peters explained that MedicationOrder.dateEnded/ReasonEnded were removed because eventHistory references Provenance.
evidence_items.learned: Community discussion is consistent with the later FHIR-8442 source history.
